_milan_kvasnicka_: Viktor Kvasnicka arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Viktor Kvasnicka was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F13 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Viktor Kvasnicka wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Viktor Kvasnicka counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The final serving took some careful scraping.
Viktor Kvasnicka began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
coletonmartin: Dorian Coletonmarti reported to S-F15 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Dorian Coletonmarti said yes, and was made to explain how anyone could tell.
After what happened at Verdel Ridge, Dorian Coletonmarti asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.
The parcel for Dorian Coletonmarti contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
yoollyfox: Bram Yoollyfox arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pressed cornflower and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
The first hundred were recognised, and Bram Yoollyfox was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
